additional_info.subject: RE: ID0387351-DC/Si-D/ES-[MP / P2 170000134] OCPP offline CRM:00642001723
additional_info.body:
Hello Fernando,
Hope you are doing well,
I was checking the logs of this charger when it goes offline and found that it only goes offline due to lost connection with server and comes online in 30 sec.
{"key":"WebSocketPingInterval","value":"0","readonly":false}
This is due to WebSocketPingIntervel is set to 0, need to set it to 30 so that server will check connection every 30 sec.
Please inform customer to update WebSocketPingInterval to 30 sec in Get & Set Configuration to improve OCPP connection.
Update us after changing this parameter.
Awaiting your response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
